main.remarks: A normalized approved issuance context exposed to assertion generators after policy approval and before final access-key material creation.

property.name: AccessPolicyContext
property.summary: Approved access-policy context that authorized the assertion-generation flow.

property.name: IssueOptions
property.summary: Normalized access-key issue options for the current issuance flow.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Optional logger available for assertion-generation helpers.

property.name: ManifestIdentity
property.summary: Resolved tool manifest identity for the issuing access manager.

property.name: Request
property.summary: Original access request when issuance was request-driven; otherwise null.

property.name: RequestedKeyType
property.summary: Canonical requested key-type token for the current issuance flow.

property.name: RequestContext
property.summary: Normalized request context when issuance was request-driven; otherwise null.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Resolved subject for the current issuance flow.

property.name: Tool
property.summary: Owning tool for the issuing access manager.
